name: Gifting
tagline: A mechanic that allows users to send items, currency, or resources to other users, creating cooperative social interactions.
desc: Royal Match runs three parallel gifting systems. The mechanic works because it converts the game's primary friction point, running out of lives, into its primary social moment. A player who has run out of lives and has no teammates has a reason to join a team.
principle: Friction becomes social glue. The resource limit creates the need; the gifting mechanic provides a social resolution to that need.
warn: Gifting systems create social obligation that some users find stressful. The mechanic works best when giving is frictionless and receiving is not conditional on reciprocity.
lifecycle: Mid-to-late lifecycle. Most effective once the user has an established social graph within the app.
